noBranding: No branding yet: add a logo, colour and company name.
freeNote: Reports are drawn from the modules' current data; no data source is paid.
noBrowser: PDFs need Chrome, Chromium or Edge on this computer. Excel and HTML can always be downloaded.
emptyText: Create a report for {domain} with your agency's brand to send to your client.
name: Report name
partsHint: Ticked parts appear in this order; move them with the arrows.
scheduleHint: Weekly or monthly sends the report as a PDF to the recipients; the first goes out shortly after saving. "After each snapshot" sends it whenever a new snapshot is taken.
noEmail: E-mail delivery exists only in the web version with e-mail set up.
recipientsHint: One address per line or comma separated; at most {n}. Replies go to your account's e-mail address.
brandingHint: These show on the reports of every project (white label).
logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG; at most 300 KB.
logoType: The logo must be PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG.
logoSize: The logo can be at most 300 KB.
hideOctopuson: Do not show "Prepared with OctopusOn SEO"
sending: The report is being sent; its state shows in the sidebar.
deleteConfirm: Delete the "{name}" report with its link and delivery history?
previewHint: The page the PDF, the link and the e-mail show, drawn from current data.
shareHint: Anyone with the link sees the report without signing in; it is drawn from current data each time.
copyFailed: The link could not be copied; select it in the box and copy it.
unshared: The link was taken away and no longer opens.
partHint_summary: The headline numbers of every module
partHint_rankings: Visibility, average position, trend and keyword table
partHint_search_console: Clicks, impressions, daily chart, queries and pages
partHint_site_audit: Health, GEO readiness and main issues
partHint_ai_visibility: Mention rate, assistants and share of voice
partHint_backlinks: From the kept backlink and domain summaries
partHint_comparison: The first snapshot against the latest: a written summary, the numbers and what changed
part_comparison_previous: Before / after: since the last snapshot
partHint_comparison_previous: The last two snapshots: the month's progress
designHint: How the PDF, the link and the e-mail look. Change the accent colour under Branding.
customizeHint: Change colours for this report only. The ones you leave keep the design's colours; text colours adjust by themselves to stay readable.
colorHint_accent: Section numbers, contents, charts and bars
colorHint_accent2: The second colour of gradients and chart lines
colorHint_table: The background of table head rows
previewLiveHint: How the report looks before saving
partHint_local: The map grid, average rank, share of local voice, rating and who beats you in the local pack
partHint_organic: The Site Explorer summary already fetched: traffic, keywords, the monthly trend; keywords up, down, new and lost
partHint_link_history: Authority and referring domains over time, links won and lost by month, risky sites and link work
partHint_gap: Shared, missing, weak and strong keyword counts; the most valuable missing and weak keywords
partHint_keyword_lists: The project's lists: keyword counts, searches in all and each list's most searched keywords
partHint_opportunities: Open opportunities by impact and effort: what, where and how many clicks it may bring
